'''Grand Admiral Tsung BHBM''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 23 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 BHBM Tsung DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Location, Location, Location (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Tournament Tomorrow... and I just threw this together... HELP!!! *note- these are just cards I own, so don't go telling me to add Emperor Palpitine instead.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published: the Weapons header says 8 but lists 7; the starting section has no count.
* Posted Tat: D-Bay dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; AAT dested Armored Attack Tank; Maul's Saber dested Maul's Lightsaber; Mara Jade dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; Boba Fett (unmarked) dested the printed Boba Fett.
* Original-era (V) cards: Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6), Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5).

== Strategy ==

Since I'm playing Corran Antillies Profit Deck I usually grab Luke as soon as possible. Then I quickly try to win as many battles as possible. Unfortunately, that's about as far in depth as I've ever gotten...

If I can't find Vader Early on, Search for a Location, check to see if DLOTS is there and pull him using Bad Feeling. If they play space, set up quick drains at all three +1 sites and get Vader to a BG as fast as possible. Help? I think I should probably have more Red Cards, but which ones?
